title: Lakeshore Marathon 2026 results
brief: The race director of the Lakeshore Marathon, held Sunday 2026-10-11, wants a results summary page for the website. 3499 runners started and 3412 finished (97.5 percent), 87 did not finish. Median finish time was 4:21:08. Sections: "Race at a glance", "Finish times", "Winners", "Highlights". Weather was 14 degrees Celsius at the start with a light headwind on the lakefront stretch. Overall winners: men's, Daniel Kiprop, 2:19:44; women's, Elena Moretti, 2:38:12. Finishers by finish-time band: under 3:00 118; 3:00 to 3:29 304; 3:30 to 3:59 612; 4:00 to 4:29 891; 4:30 to 4:59 703; 5:00 to 5:29 489; 5:30 and over 295. Age-group winners: 18 to 29, Mateus Oliveira 2:31:55 and Hannah Berg 2:54:30; 30 to 39, Samuel Adeyemi 2:28:02 and Ines Duarte 2:49:18; 40 to 49, Rolf Jansen 2:41:37 and Corinne Leclerc 3:01:44; 50 and over, Tadashi Mori 2:58:09 and Margaret O'Hara 3:12:51. Add a few facts for the highlight list: 41 percent of finishers were running their first marathon, 23 countries were represented, and a record 1180 volunteers staffed 14 aid stations. Include a note that official chip times are final and results may still change if a protest is upheld before 2026-10-25.

edit.request: A timing error was found: Daniel Kiprop's official time is 2:19:41, not 2:19:44, and the 4:00 to 4:29 band should be 893 finishers with the 4:30 to 4:59 band 701.
